'''The Diamond Hunter''' is a power [[Books|book]] that can be traded from the [[Volcano Dungeon#Shop|Volcano Dwarf]] in the [[Volcano Dungeon]] for 10 [[Diamond]]s.

The first reading grants the player a power that makes all stones have a 0.66% chance to drop a diamond when mined with a [[Pickaxes|pickaxe]], with a 50% chance to drop double if the player has the [[Skills#Mining|Geologist]] profession.<ref name="bookfunction" /> These drops are not affected by [[Mastery Cave#Masteries|Mining Mastery]]. Once read, it can be found in [[the Player]]'s menu on the [[Special Items & Powers]] tab. Each subsequent reading gives the player 100 [[Mining]] [[Skills|XP]].

==Bundles==
The Diamond Hunter is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
The Diamond Hunter is not used in any [[tailoring]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a blue dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a cyan dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
The Diamond Hunter is not used in any [[quests]].
